upgrades.name: Auxiliary Power
upgrades.tooltip: Bring the ship's auxiliary systems online for every run: Drone Swarm, Graviton Cascade and Genesis Pulse, each with its own talent tree. Buy power cells with gems to learn system talents; cells and talents reset when you extract the core.

upgrades.name: Command Center
upgrades.tooltip: Unlock the command center and activate fleet commands during each run.

upgrades.name: Overloaded Holds
upgrades.tooltip: Double fleet cargo capacity. Ships consume twice as much fuel while carrying cargo.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Affects Drifters, Seekers, Rimrunners, Prospectors and Trove Hunters. Empty ships retain their normal fuel use.

upgrades.name: Fleet Requisition
upgrades.tooltip: For every five ships purchased of a fleet type, deploy one additional ship of that type for free.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Bonus ships update automatically as ship-count upgrades are purchased. Command drones are not fleet ships.

upgrades.name: Deep-Core Munitions
upgrades.tooltip: Planet weapons mine one quality layer deeper, but launch their gems 40% farther across the field.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Improves gem-color rolls without increasing the number of gems knocked loose. Applies to all gems mined from the planet.

upgrades.name: Target Painter
upgrades.tooltip: Click the planet to paint a target for 8 seconds. Automatic weapons focus it and produce twice as many gems, but always fire at 65% speed.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Repainting refreshes the duration. Manual cannon shots retain normal output; painted output remains limited by field capacity.

upgrades.name: Cargo Catapult
upgrades.tooltip: Fleet deliveries feed their momentum into the homebase arsenal, advancing every automatic weapon timer by up to 4 seconds.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Larger cargo loads provide more charge. Instant delivery effects bypass the catapult.

upgrades.name: Combined Arms
upgrades.tooltip: Each additional automatic planet weapon online increases the output of every automatic weapon by 20%.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Counts Auto Cannon, Mining Laser, Rocket Pods and Big Space Gun. With all four online, each produces 60% more gems.

upgrades.name: Project Constellation
upgrades.tooltip: Rocket salvos wait in orbit. Firing the Big Space Gun calls every stored rocket onto its impact point with 50% greater payload.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Up to 64 rockets can wait in orbit. Without a Big Space Gun, the constellation launches itself after 12 seconds.

upgrades.name: Command Chain
upgrades.tooltip: Activating a fleet command removes 25% of every other command's remaining cooldown.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Command Center. Chaining different commands rewards rotating through the full command bar.

upgrades.name: Multicast Mastery
upgrades.tooltip: Ship system multicast rolls use four additional mastery levels, unlocking triple, quadruple and quintuple echoes.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Multicast Protocol. Delayed echoes cannot recursively multicast.

upgrades.name: Command Nexus
upgrades.tooltip: All fleet commands unlock at the start of a run and recharge 30% faster. Activating a command also removes 25% of every other command's remaining cooldown.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Command Center. Rotate through the whole command bar to keep it charged.

upgrades.name: Weaponized Compression
upgrades.tooltip: Matter Compression becomes unstable: every merged gem retains twice the combined value of the gems consumed.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Matter Compression. Fewer gems remain on the field, but each successful compression creates value.

upgrades.name: System Cooldowns
upgrades.tooltip: Reduce cooldowns for all ship systems. Stacks multiplicatively with each system's cooldown upgrades.

upgrades.name: Multicast Protocol
upgrades.tooltip: Unlocks a 10% chance for a ship system to fire twice.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Multicast rolls once per activation. 2x to 5x means total casts, including the original. Extra casts follow at 0.25-second intervals and cannot trigger another multicast.

upgrades.name: Multicast Power
upgrades.tooltip: Improve multicast chances and unlock higher cast counts.

upgrades.name: Gem Value
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the bonus value of gems.

upgrades.name: Gem Value Multiplier
upgrades.tooltip: Increase the value for gems by a multiplier.

upgrades.name: Matter Compression
upgrades.tooltip: Every five nearby loose gems compress into one gem holding their combined value, trading collection triggers for field space.

upgrades.name: Gem Merger Bonus
upgrades.tooltip: Increase bonus base value for combined gems.

upgrades.name: Gem Merger Multiplier
upgrades.tooltip: Increase multiplier for combined gems.

upgrades.name: All Harvester Speed
upgrades.tooltip: Increase speed for ALL harvester types.

upgrades.name: Dimensional Cargo Bays
upgrades.tooltip: Increase cargo capacity for every harvester type.

upgrades.name: Tractor Matrix
upgrades.tooltip: Increase collection range for every harvester type.

upgrades.name: Antimatter Tanks
upgrades.tooltip: Increase maximum fuel for every harvester type.

upgrades.name: Closed-Cycle Drives
upgrades.tooltip: Increase fuel efficiency for every harvester type.

upgrades.name: Recall Engines
upgrades.tooltip: All full harvesters travel back to the home base faster.

upgrades.name: Fleet Refinery
upgrades.tooltip: Multiply the value delivered by every harvester type.

upgrades.name: Jackpot Haul
upgrades.tooltip: Every fleet delivery has a 5% chance to become a 5x jackpot, with a rare chance for a 10x mega jackpot.

upgrades.name: Resonance Cascade
upgrades.tooltip: Every 50 fleet collections trigger 6 seconds of +75% speed and +25% collection range for all harvesters.

upgrades.name: Quantum Entanglement
upgrades.tooltip: Harvesters pair across the fleet. Each collected gem sends 25% of its value to the linked ship without consuming cargo space.

upgrades.name: Phase Logistics
upgrades.tooltip: Fleet ships phase every collected gem directly home at 75% value, eliminating return trips but bypassing cargo and delivery effects.

upgrades.name: Ability Slot
upgrades.tooltip: Unlocks an additional ability slot.

upgrades.name: Shipyard
upgrades.tooltip: Unlock the Shipyard: salvage modules during runs and fit them to your fleet classes. Finds come every minute or two; modules are lost when you extract the core.

upgrades.name: Module Bays
upgrades.tooltip: Add one module slot to every harvester type, up to 4 slots. The slots are permanent.

upgrades.name: Deep Space Signals
upgrades.tooltip: Unlock paid scans for permanent, stacking signal bonuses. Discoveries and scan progress persist through prestige.

upgrades.name: Command Amplifier
upgrades.tooltip: Strengthen manual commands: longer Overdrive, stronger Magnetizer, faster System Surge recharge, bigger Reserve Burst bonus and stronger collector drones. +20% command power per rank.

upgrades.name: Precision Harvest
upgrades.tooltip: Permanently add +100% click value per rank. Two ranks make clicked gems worth three times their base value. Applies to direct clicks, Gem Link, shockwaves and mouse meta effects.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Stacks multiplicatively with run upgrades and signals.

upgrades.name: Wide Survey
upgrades.tooltip: Double your click collection radius in one purchase. Also doubles the mouse gravity well radius.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Stacks with run upgrades and signals. Pointer rings show the effective targeting radius.

upgrades.name: Quantum Touch
upgrades.tooltip: Every successful click also collects up to 32 gems at the mirrored cursor position across the homebase. You can collect through either end of this link. Both ends share the same click bonus.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Works with Sustained Harvest. Mirror collections do not repeat Gem Link or shockwaves.

upgrades.name: Event Horizon
upgrades.tooltip: Your mouse gravity well automatically harvests loose gems inside its inner quarter-radius at double click value. Pull gems into the core without clicking each one.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Gravity Well in the run tree. Harvests up to 16 gems per frame and leaves harvester reservations untouched.

upgrades.name: Gravity Mastery
upgrades.tooltip: Hold right-click to steer your mouse gravity well. It also harvests loose gems inside its inner quarter-radius at double click value, so you can sweep the field with it.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Gravity Well in the run tree. Harvests up to 16 gems per frame; steering does not restart duration or cooldown.

upgrades.name: Singularity Collapse
upgrades.tooltip: When your mouse gravity well expires, it detonates and harvests up to 128 loose gems inside its full radius at triple click value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Gravity Well in the run tree. Cancellation does not trigger a collapse. Harvester reservations remain protected.

upgrades.name: Planet Cracker Core
upgrades.tooltip: Permanently make the Planet Cracker command knock loose 10% more gems per rank. Command Amplifier and Planet Cracker signals multiply this bonus.

upgrades.name: Combo Supernova
upgrades.tooltip: Every fifth consecutive successful click releases a supernova, harvesting up to 32 extra loose gems in a 180-unit radius at triple that click's value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: The radius grows to twice your click radius if that is larger. Keep clicking before the combo timer expires; Sustained Harvest also charges the burst.

upgrades.name: Thermite Rounds
upgrades.tooltip: Cannon shells burn into the planet: every cannon hit leaves a molten crater that oozes half of its gems again over 4 seconds. The laser's Magma Scars burn twice as long.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Craters come from clicked and automatic shots, ricochets and drone shells. Rockets and the Big Space Gun can detonate them with Magma Detonation.

upgrades.name: Lightning Rod
upgrades.tooltip: While the Arc Harpoon is anchored, cannon hits arc into its cable: every hit adds an extra pulse, a critical hit three, up to ten extra pulses per anchor. Between anchors the harpoon reloads twice as fast.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Arc Harpoon in the run tree. Gatling Cannon, Ricochet Rounds and Drone Gunships all add hits.

upgrades.name: Beam Riders
upgrades.tooltip: Every 3 seconds each mining laser beam fires a rocket that rides the beam into the planet. Beam rockets use rocket fire power and every rocket upgrade, including Cluster Warheads, Orbital Strike, Rocket Swarm and Project Constellation.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Mining Laser and Rocket Pods in the run tree. Laser fire rate shortens the interval; Twin and Quad Lasers fire more rockets.

upgrades.name: Magma Detonation
upgrades.tooltip: Rocket and Big Space Gun impacts detonate the molten scars and craters around them: each bursts at once and releases twice the gems it had left to ooze.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Works with Magma Scars, Thermite Rounds and Incendiary Warheads. Detonations do not chain into each other.

upgrades.name: Echo Protocol
upgrades.tooltip: Ship systems have a 25% chance to echo and fire twice. Every ship system activation, echoes included, fires a three-shell cannon volley at the planet.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Auxiliary Power. Volleys use the cannon's fire power and its specials, even without Auto Cannon.

upgrades.name: Main Battery Relay
upgrades.tooltip: When the Big Space Gun fires, every other weapon answers: the cannon fires a five-shell volley, the rocket pods launch a salvo, the harpoon reloads or pulses at once and the laser overcharges at triple output for 2 seconds.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Big Space Gun in the run tree. Only weapons you own answer.

upgrades.name: Drone Gunships
upgrades.tooltip: Drone Swarm drones carry micro-cannons: every drone fires a cannon shell at the planet when it launches and again when its time runs out.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Auxiliary Power and Drone Swarm. Shells use the cannon's fire power, Critical Shells, Ricochet Rounds and Thermite Rounds.

upgrades.name: Shard Reactor
upgrades.tooltip: Every Core Shard you hold unspent makes your planet weapons deal 20% more damage. Collecting a Core Shard fires every weapon at once.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Spend a shard on a powerful upgrade, or hold it to power the arsenal: the choice is yours each run.

upgrades.name: Signal Resonance
upgrades.tooltip: Every signal you own makes your planet weapons knock loose 1% more gems, up to 100%. Every 25 signals also let them mine one quality layer deeper, up to five.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Counts every signal stack you have collected, in every category.

upgrades.name: Planetary Overload
upgrades.tooltip: Every 500 gems your weapons knock loose build pressure in the planet. At full pressure it erupts: a quake sheds a ring of 120 gems at your strongest weapon's fire power and every weapon fires at once.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: The planet glows brighter as pressure builds. It erupts at most once every 8 seconds; the eruption also charges the Big Space Gun, which can set off Main Battery Relay.

upgrades.name: Armed Escorts
upgrades.tooltip: Fleet ships fitted with modules are armed: every delivery fires one cannon shell at the planet for each module the ship carries.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Shipyard. Shells lob over the field and use the cannon's fire power, Critical Shells, Ricochet Rounds, Thermite Rounds and Lightning Rod.
